title: Orthonormal basis adapted to a linear functional: α(u_0) = ‖α‖ and α(u_j) = 0 for j ≠ 0 (parent Steps 4–5)
statement: For every P ∈ ℕ and every continuous linear functional α : ℝ^P → ℝ (Eucl P →L[ℝ] ℝ) there is an orthonormal basis u = (u_0,…,u_{P−1}) of ℝ^P, indexed by Fin P, such that for every j ∈ Fin P: α(u_j) = ‖α‖ (the operator norm) if j = 0, and α(u_j) = 0 if j ≠ 0. No hypothesis α ≠ 0 is needed: for α = 0 the standard basis works.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (α : Eucl P →L[ℝ] ℝ), ∃ u : OrthonormalBasis (Fin P) ℝ (Eucl P), ∀ j : Fin P, α (u j) = if (j : ℕ) = 0 then ‖α‖ else 0
